Running Python code interactively: # Let's analyze the existing corpus file
with open('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openthread/tests/fuzz/corpora/radio-receive-done/mle-parent-request', 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read()

print(f"Length: {len(data)} bytes")
print(f"Hex: {data.hex()}")
print()

# IEEE 802.15.4 frame format:
# Byte 0-1: Frame Control Field
fcf = data[0] | (data[1] << 8)
print(f"FCF: 0x{fcf:04x}")
print(f"  Frame Type: {fcf & 0x7}")
print(f"  Security Enabled: {(fcf >> 3) & 1}")
print(f"  Frame Pending: {(fcf >> 4) & 1}")
print(f"  Ack Request: {(fcf >> 5) & 1}")
print(f"  PAN ID Compression: {(fcf >> 6) & 1}")
print(f"  Dest Addr Mode: {(fcf >> 10) & 3}")
print(f"  Frame Version: {(fcf >> 12) & 3}")
print(f"  Src Addr Mode: {(fcf >> 14) & 3}")

# Byte 2: Sequence Number
dsn = data[2]
print(f"DSN: {dsn}")

# Parse addresses based on FCF
offset = 3
dest_addr_mode = (fcf >> 10) & 3
src_addr_mode = (fcf >> 14) & 3
pan_id_compression = (fcf >> 6) & 1

print(f"\nDest Addr Mode: {dest_addr_mode}, Src Addr Mode: {src_addr_mode}, PAN ID Compression: {pan_id_compression}")

if dest_addr_mode == 2:  # 16-bit short
    if not pan_id_compression:
        dst_pan = data[offset] | (data[offset+1] << 8)
        offset += 2
        print(f"Dst PAN: 0x{dst_pan:04x}")
    dst_addr = data[offset] | (data[offset+1] << 8)
    offset += 2
    print(f"Dst Addr: 0x{dst_addr:04x}")
elif dest_addr_mode == 3:  # 64-bit extended
    if not pan_id_compression:
        dst_pan = data[offset] | (data[offset+1] << 8)
        offset += 2
        print(f"Dst PAN: 0x{dst_pan:04x}")
    dst_addr = data[offset:offset+8]
    offset += 8
    print(f"Dst Addr: {dst_addr.hex()}")

if src_addr_mode == 2:  # 16-bit short
    if pan_id_compression:
        src_pan = data[offset] | (data[offset+1] << 8)
        offset += 2
        print(f"Src PAN: 0x{src_pan:04x}")
    src_addr = data[offset] | (data[offset+1] << 8)
    offset += 2
    print(f"Src Addr: 0x{src_addr:04x}")
elif src_addr_mode == 3:  # 64-bit extended
    if pan_id_compression:
        src_pan = data[offset] | (data[offset+1] << 8)
        offset += 2
        print(f"Src PAN: 0x{src_pan:04x}")
    src_addr = data[offset:offset+8]
    offset += 8
    print(f"Src Addr: {src_addr.hex()}")

print(f"\nPayload starts at offset {offset}")
print(f"Payload hex: {data[offset:].hex()}")
print(f"Payload length: {len(data) - offset}")
